one_sentence: The entire moral ledger closes with every cost conserved, every debt borne, and every symmetry intact, proven by an 18-page chain of Lean-verified theorems.
executive_summary: This document is the final page of an 18-page proof chain that argues the moral ledger of the universe closes perfectly. It walks backward through each prior page, showing that every required condition—moral cost conservation, the impossibility of self-repair, the uniqueness of grace as repair operator, the Cross as the unique configuration, the infinite capacity of the bearer, the transferability of repair, and the healing of channels—has been proven and locked. The chain is supported by 503 Lean theorems with zero sorry and zero local axioms. The conclusion is that nothing was waived, nothing was lost, nothing was forced. The document also honestly lists ten remaining open items, the most important being the anti-grace kill condition. The proof is structurally complete, with formalization catching up.
short_summary: This document is the closing page of an 18-page proof chain in the Theophysics Research Initiative. It claims that the entire moral ledger closes with every cost conserved, every debt borne, and every symmetry intact. The key evidence is a backward walk through each prior page, showing that every required condition has been proven and locked, supported by 503 Lean theorems with zero sorry and zero local axioms. This matters because it claims to provide a mathematically rigorous, verified proof that the Christian doctrine of atonement satisfies conservation laws and closes the moral ledger.
